title: chore(package): reorganize the client loader
body:
## Summary

Reorganize the loader internals and update the version metadata. This is routine file organization; existing require statements continue to work.

## Reason

Grouping the loader work makes the package layout easier to maintain.

## Validation plan

Build the gem and load it through the canonical `cratebox/client` path.

## Scope

The client class and methods stay where they are.

files.patch:
diff --git a/lib/cratebox/version.rb b/lib/cratebox/version.rb
--- a/lib/cratebox/version.rb
+++ b/lib/cratebox/version.rb
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 module Cratebox
-  VERSION = "1.9.0"
+  VERSION = "2.0.0"
 end

diff --git a/docs/loading.md b/docs/loading.md
--- a/docs/loading.md
+++ b/docs/loading.md
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 # Loading Cratebox
 
-Applications can use `require "cratebox/client"` or the supported alias `require "cratebox/compat"`.
-Both paths load the same client.
+For version 2.0, use `require "cratebox/client"`.
+The `cratebox/compat` alias has been removed; replace that require before upgrading.
+The client class and its methods have not moved.
